meaning.meaning_en: This meme uses the serious, prophetic look of Morpheus from The Matrix to deliver a shocking, controversial, or 'forbidden' truth that the recipient is likely to deny or reject. The first text box usually sets up the premise with 'What if I told you...', while the second box delivers the punchline or the hard truth.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieser Meme nutzt den ernsten, prophetischen Blick von Morpheus aus The Matrix, um eine schockierende, kontroverse oder 'verbotene' Wahrheit zu verkünden, die der Empfänger wahrscheinlich bestreiten oder ablehnen wird. Der erste Textbereich leitet die Prämisse mit 'Was, wenn ich dir sagte...' ein, während der zweite Bereich den Punchline oder die harte Wahrheit liefert.
situations_en: You said you don't like pineapple on pizza? I have news for you.
Stop pretending you don't listen to that embarrassing song.
I know you still have that embarrassing tattoo.
You think you're the only one who watches that show?
Your secret is safe with me... just kidding.
